C1253.title: Shanghai Pudong Cross-Border Credit Card Fraud and Chargeback Case
C1253.summary: Starting in January 2025, Zhang, Wang, and others obtained foreign credit card information and conducted fake cross-border transactions on domestic POS terminals to defraud domestic banks of settlement funds.
